test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Mechanic Diesel) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is not the purpose of lubricating oil in an engine?

options.text: Dewaxing to improve low temperature fluidity.
Separation of low boiling substances like gasoline, jet fuel, diesel etc.
Finishing to improve oxidation and heat stability.
To evenly mix impurities including aromatic and polar compounds.

solution:
The correct answer is __To evenly mix impurities including aromatic and polar compounds.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Lubricating oil__ is used to reduce friction, wear, and tear in an engine.
 
• It provides cooling by removing heat generated during engine operation.
 
• Lubricating oil reduces corrosion and prevents the deposition of impurities.
 
• It improves engine performance and ensures smooth operation.
 
• The statement about evenly mixing impurities, including aromatic and polar compounds, is not a purpose of lubricating oil.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Dewaxing:**

 
 
• Dewaxing is done to improve the low-temperature fluidity of lubricating oil.
 
• It ensures that the oil flows easily even in cold weather conditions.
 
 
 
• **Separation of low boiling substances:**
 
 
• This process is used in the refining of crude oil to separate products like gasoline, jet fuel, and diesel.
 
• It is a critical step in obtaining lubricating oil from crude oil.
 
 
 
• **Finishing:**
 
 
• Finishing enhances the oxidation and heat stability of lubricating oil.
 
• It ensures the oil maintains its properties under high-stress conditions.
